summary: Always writes 1.0f to this+4. Writes 1.0f to this+8 when a2 is not positive; when a2 is greater than 0.0f, writes the reciprocal 1.0f / a2 to this+8 instead.

operations.description: this+4 is always set to 1.0f (bit pattern 1065353216).
Branch on whether a2 is greater than 0.0f.
Otherwise this+8 is set to 1.0f (bit pattern 1065353216).
